messages.author: 5dadf4dbf792b603
messages.subject: Error in if (tmp < 0) Mrate <- exp(tmp) :    missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Dear all,

I got the following error after I tried to fit a bifactor model with the bfactor function (see code below). The odd thing is that the code works with different data.
However, I don't know what the problem could be because the data for which the code works is not different than the "ADM" data except for the difference in responses to the items and the labels to the items is different in the two data sets.
Does anyone has an idea would could be the problem?

Error:
"Error in if (tmp < 0) Mrate <- exp(tmp) : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"

Code:
"ADMm <- '
Adm = 1-9'

modelADM <- mirt.model(ADMm)
specific <- c(1,1,NA,NA,2,1,NA,2,2)
ADMbf <- bfactor(data=ADM, model=specific,model2=modelADM, itemtype='graded')"
